title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How about everybody watching the stream? Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Let's see... “Good to go!”
And... “Let's do this!”
Alright, I think we're set!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's get Kagamine Rin & Kagamine Len's Special Anniversary Show started♪
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
My part's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I hope you're all ready!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
Everyone's still got tons of energy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, this is amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Doesn't it mean they want to celebrate your anniversary just that much?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How about everybody watching the stream? Can you keep going?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure they can.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I just saw someone say, “My cheering could shatter windows right now.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! I'm glad to see that they're enjoying everything, but try not to actually break any windows, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, let's just keep having fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But we still have plenty more in store for you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, the fun's just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You'll get to hear some classics, but my part of the show should feel a little different from Rin's part.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I've also thrown in some fun songs that should really make you smile and others that I'm sure you'll want to sing along to!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounds like he really wants to go for more power and energy!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So try to keep up, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you so much for coming out today to celebrate my and Rin's anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I always believed that these are twice as fun since I get to celebrate together with Rin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I realize now that it's more fun than that because we also get to celebrate with Miku and everybody else here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You may be right. It's definitely been quite a bit of fun and we're all so happy for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, exactly. So... The more the merrier...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe so. I'm sure everybody watching the stream will agree with you on that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure they do!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, the more the merrier!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, now for our last song...
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? It's playing already...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Just as we prepared special messages for Rin, we've prepared some for you as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was so caught up in my show and our surprise for Rin that I completely forgot!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But we were hoping that you'd still be surprised by it, so let's call it a happy coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! So please, if you don't mind hearing what we've prepared.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a kind and thoughtful person, Len. I hope we can keep being friends!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. She said you're kind, but I know about your mischievous side, Len.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So let's keep playing pranks on KAITO every now and then, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Every now and then? 
Hold on, MEIKO, you've been helping him...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, Len, happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your pranks never fail to startle me, but for some reason, they always end up making me smile.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I suppose I don't mind you doing these things as long as that's the result. Although, it'd be nice to be on the pranking side for a change...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Len.
Hehe. It's so wonderful how cheerful and hard-working you and Rin always seem to be.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've actually been wondering what it'd be like to be pranked by you, so please try one on me sometime.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Len!
Hehe... I'm not gonna lie, putting this into words is pretty embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But every day is fun when you're around. From hanging out to singing together... Oh, hehe... Pulling pranks on you occasionally!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And you're always the first person that comes to mind whenever I'm thinking about doing something.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So let's keep having lots and lots of fun together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, everyone... One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. I knew that you guys would be doing this since you did it during Rin's part of the show...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But... I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, thanks to all of you in the audience as well as everybody watching the stream!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I hope you guys, Rin and I can keep singing, hanging out and having fun together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And thank you all again for celebrating our anniversary like this! We really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Bye bye!
